taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Delegated browser capabilities across embeds using effective Permissions Policy
controls.source_trace: Identify the exact browser feature and how ancestor policy plus frame delegation constrains it. Separate user permission, secure-context requirements and policy denial.
controls.implementation_branch: A parent policy denying a feature cannot be broadened merely by a permissive iframe allow attribute. Record the frame origin, sandbox and user grant separately. Querying a permission status is not obtaining protected sensor data; verify the particular API operation and its policy-denied outcome.
controls.controlled_verification: In owned origins invoke only a synthetic or non-sensitive feature check with intended and untrusted embeds; record policy-denied versus user-denied outcomes.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An absent policy or permission prompt does not prove access to camera/location or any actual sensitive resource.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Limit delegation to intended origins and retest allowed embedding and policy rejection without changing user grants to manufacture a result.
